_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_cast_this_way_trigger.py. t_ctw_raid is The Ruinous Powers' upkeep line as a sorcery (exile the top card of each opponent's library, play it this turn with mana of any color, and a reflexive 'when you cast a spell this way'); t_ctw_plain_raid the same permission without the trigger; t_ctw_heist puts the trigger on exile's own permission, t_ctw_grant on grant_playable's.

cards.name: Test Ruinous Raid
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of each opponent's library. Until end of turn, you may play that card and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it. When you cast a spell this way, its owner loses life equal to its mana value.

abilities.text: When you cast a spell this way, its owner loses life equal to its mana value.

cards.oracle_text: Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard. You may cast it this turn. When you cast a spell this way, its owner loses life equal to its mana value.
